title: Dutch PHP Conference 2020 – Online Edition
content:
Due to the COVID-19 pandemic we have transformed Dutch PHP Conference 2020 to an online event. On June 26th we will offer a 1-day, single-track event free of charge for all attendees! So mark your calendar for Friday, June 26th and we hope to virtually meet you at the online edition of DPC!

https://www.phpconference.nl
author: PHP.net news & announcements
